capabilities: Sync the vault across devices in real time
Encrypt note contents and paths end-to-end
Browse and restore file version history
Recover deleted notes from a recycle bin
Park conflicting versions as separate files
extras: Open-source and self-hosted; the README is a generated build artifact and full documentation (quick start, server setup) lives at courier.dev. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer. A vault password encrypts the remote copy and is never sent to the server; losing it means the remote content cannot be decrypted (no reset). The server operator can see account/vault names, sizes, version timestamps and device labels, but not note contents, paths or passwords. No telemetry or third-party services are contacted.
problem: Keeping an Obsidian vault in sync across devices normally means paying for a hosted service or trusting a third party with your note contents.

requires.name: Courier account with a user key

summary: Self-hosted sync plugin that keeps an Obsidian vault synchronized across devices with end-to-end encryption and real-time updates.
